// Origami crane
define 200 200
textures
iad
// Diagonal (body axis)
by2d p0 p2
// Kite-fold both edges to the diagonal
bisector2d s1 s4
bisector2d s2 s4
offset -1 f1
t 250 r s6 -180 p1
offset -1 f3
t 250 r s8 180 p3
// Neck, tail, and head creases
split s4 0.28
perpendicular3d s4 p6
split s9 0.75
perpendicular3d s9 p11
split s4 0.4
perpendicular3d s4 p14
// Raise the neck, then fold the head forward
t 300 r s17 -90 p2 p14 p15 p16 p17 p18
t 250 r s31 100 p2
// Raise the tail
t 250 r s22 80 p0
// Face the camera: body along x, then a 3/4 view
t 200 tz -45
t 200 ty 55
t 200 tx -18
t 200 fit
// Show
iao
t 1000 z 0.5 0 0
t 1000 fit
iao
t 1000 ty 360
